## Summary
- **Fixed bug**: CustomTooltip now uses the configurable `NextButtonText`/`FinishButtonText` props instead of hardcoded "Next"/"Finish" strings
- **Accessibility**: Added `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, auto-focus, Escape key support, ARIA labels on progress dots, `aria-live` on fraction display, and WCAG-compliant `:focus-visible` outlines
- **React stability**: ObservedStepContent nodes now receive stable `key` props via `item.id` to prevent unnecessary remounts

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify Next/Finish button labels reflect configured text in widget properties
- [ ] Verify pressing Escape closes the tour
- [ ] Verify tooltip receives focus when the tour starts and on each step change
- [ ] Verify screen reader announces "Tour step X of Y" when tooltip appears
- [ ] Verify dot indicators have proper ARIA labels \(inspect with accessibility tools\)
- [ ] Verify focus outlines appear on keyboard navigation but not on mouse click
- [ ] Verify build passes \(`npm run build`\)

EOF
